title: Speak Readings>"Or per number of minutes" text is too large
symptom: The text for 'Speak Readings' and 'Or per number of minutes' is too large compared to other text on that page, making it impossible to see the current setting (number of minutes). The font size is out of proportion to all other text.
cause: The standard text size while rendering the SeekBar is bigger than other Preferences types, as observed in all Prefs where the seekbar is used.
fix: No definitive fix was stated. A workaround is to rotate the phone to see the setting completely. A potential fix suggested by MasterPlexus is adding android:textSize="5sp" to all SeekBarPreference's in pref_advanced_settings.xml, but this was not confirmed by jamorham. Jamorham suggested a custom layout for SeekBarPreference but encountered a crash.
evidence_quote: The only outsized fonts on that page seem to be the two lines that I mentioned in the OP.
